statements.impact_statement: The overflow is in tpm2daemon handling TPM-backed private-key operations. The reviewed image ships ordinary GnuPG tools but no tpm2daemon package or executable. Applies only to the exact package in the immutable WebUI image, conditional on CI component-absence evidence; excludes the host and user-installed tools.
